decision.reasoning_trace: The search for a standard, versatile backpack was met with a selection that was either too specialized or too lightweight. While the HIKPRO (prod_backpacks_006) is highly rated, it is a packable daypack lacking structure for daily heavy use. The other options in the consideration set are strictly niche: hydration-focused (prod_backpacks_078, prod_backpacks_150), hunting-specific (prod_backpacks_095), or designed for ski boots (prod_backpacks_186). The only standard canvas backpack available (prod_backpacks_031) is overpriced and poorly rated. Without a high-quality, structured daily-use or travel backpack, I am opting for no purchase in this session.
